overloadPatches.semanticRole: Opens the current input form as an interactive Query by Example window for aTable, using indexed fields automatically to optimize the resulting query.

constraints: The input form must contain the fields the user should be able to query on.
The trailing '*' here only suppresses the scrolling status bar during the query; unlike QUERY's trailing '*', it is not a multi-call continuation flag -- QUERY BY EXAMPLE is always a single call.
